title: Aushang
description: Public notice for residents of a multi-family house (MFH) announcing meter-change appointments. Created automatically when ≥2 Aufträge target the same address in the same week. Currently described in AUSHANG-LOGIK.md but not implemented; this schema is greenfield-design.

adresse.description: Building address; primary key together with kalenderwoche+jahr.

kalenderwoche.description: ISO calendar week. Aushang is generated for week+2 (per AUSHANG-LOGIK.md).

auftragIds.description: All Aufträge that share this address in the week. minItems=2 enforces the MFH-only rule.

bestaetigt.description: Whether a Monteur has confirmed the Aushang was posted on-site.

pdfPath.description: Blob storage path to the generated Anwohnerinfo PDF.
